title: Binding profile of a mixed-ligand silver(I) complex with DNA and Topoisomerase I.
authors: Movahedi, Elaheh; Razmazma, Hafez; Rezvani, Alireza; Ebrahimi, Ali
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银(I)配合物与DNA及拓扑异构酶I的结合谱，采用分子对接和ONIOM模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移。
abstract: A new mixed-ligand Ag(I) complex, [Ag(daf)(phen)]NO(3) (daf = 4,5-diazafluoren-9-one and dian = N-(4,5-diazafluoren-9-ylidene)aniline), was synthesized. The elemental analysis, FTIR, (1)HNMR, UV-Vis spectroscopy, cyclic voltammetry, and DFT (Density Functional Theory) geometry optimization method were applied in order to predict the Ag(I) complex structure which concluded to a distorted tetrahedral N4 coordination around the Ag(I) center. A detailed in silico analysis of the bioaffinity of the complex to DNA and human DNA-Topoisomerase I was conducted using molecular docking simulations and ONIOM (Our own N-layered Integrated molecular Orbital and molecular Mechanics) techniques. In this overall scenario, the results suggest the dominance of pi-pi stacking interactions of the heteroaromatic ligands in the intercalating pocket of DNA and the active site of the enzyme and the rational correlation between being a good intercalator and a potent Topoisomerase I inhibitor. In vitro DNA-binding experiments by spectrophotometric, spectro fl uorometric, Voltammetric, and viscometric techniques at physiological pH also confirmed the computational results. The complex inhibited MCF-7 cell growth in a dose-dependent manner while being nontoxic on HUVEC normal cells.
abstract_zh: 合成了一种新型混合配体Ag(I)配合物[Ag(daf)(phen)]NO(3)（daf = 4,5-二氮杂芴-9-酮，dian = N-(4,5-二氮杂芴-9-亚基)苯胺）。采用元素分析、FTIR、¹HNMR、UV-Vis光谱、循环伏安法及DFT（密度泛函理论）几何优化方法预测Ag(I)配合物结构，结果表明Ag(I)中心周围形成畸变的四面体N4配位环境。通过分子对接模拟和ONIOM（我们的分层整合分子轨道与分子力学）技术，对配合物与DNA及人DNA-拓扑异构酶I的生物亲和力进行了详细的计算机模拟分析。总体而言，结果表明杂芳香配体在DNA嵌入口袋和酶活性位点中的π-π堆积相互作用占主导地位，且良好的嵌入剂与有效的拓扑异构酶I抑制剂之间存在合理相关性。在生理pH下，通过分光光度法、荧光光谱法、伏安法和粘度法进行的体外DNA结合实验也证实了计算结果。该配合物以剂量依赖性方式抑制MCF-7细胞生长，同时对HUVEC正常细胞无毒。
